digest.overview: 今日条目集中在OLED与microLED两条主线：智能手机OLED面板出货量预计下滑，但折叠/卷曲OLED保持两位数增长；同时LG Display的OLED TV窄边框驱动电路技术获奖，显示面板端仍在通过结构与电路优化降本。microLED方面，韩国Lumens Bios加码量产与micro RGB，另有MOCVD与microLED测试设备重新挂牌出售，反映研发与产线资源仍在流动。

news.title_zh: 今年智能手机OLED出货量负增长，折叠屏增长23%
news.summary_zh: 据Counterpoint Research数据，今年全球智能手机OLED面板出货量预计为8.29亿片，较去年的8.94亿片减少约7%，主因存储供应受限与生产成本上升。分类型看，刚性OLED出货量同比减少24%，柔性OLED减少3%，而折叠OLED保持两位数增长。
news.why: 智能手机OLED整体需求承压，面板厂需依靠折叠等高端形态维持增长与价格。

news.title_zh: Lumens Bios（原Lumens）将扩展microLED显示业务
news.summary_zh: 韩国LED厂商Lumens Bios（2026年9月前名为Lumens）表示将在保留原有LED业务的同时，拓展microLED与micro RGB等下一代显示业务。公司正投资microLED量产、扩大对国防行业的microLED供应，并投资micro RGB生产设备；其有源矩阵microLED微显示已用于瑞典Aimpoint的军用瞄具。
news.why: microLED从微显示与国防等利基市场切入，有助于带动量产设备与供应链成熟。

news.title_zh: Counterpoint：2026年智能手机OLED面板出货量将下降3%，折叠OLED出货量将增长23%
news.summary_zh: Counterpoint Research称，全球智能手机OLED面板出货量将从2025年的8.94亿片降至2026年的8.29亿片，降幅近3%，受存储供应危机与生产成本上升影响。刚性OLED出货量将下降24%，柔性OLED下降3%，而折叠与卷曲OLED将增长超过23%；今年智能手机OLED面板收入预计下降超过5%。
news.why: 面板价格与出货双重承压，折叠与卷曲等高端形态成为收入增长的主要支撑。

news.title_zh: 案例：Yousee Display以柔性AMOLED与“零死角”3D曲面贴合打造富有表现力的机器人面部
news.summary_zh: 人形机器人正从实验室走向酒店、商场、教室与家庭，面部显示屏成为重要交互界面，但曲面贴合精度、画质一致性与表面防护制约规模化部署。深圳Yousee Display推出集成式机器人面部方案，结合柔性AMOLED显示模组、“零死角”3D曲面成型与贴合技术及定制盖板透镜，实现无可见缝隙与死区的连续数字面部。
news.why: 柔性AMOLED在新兴机器人交互场景落地，为面板厂打开非消费电子增量市场。

news.title_zh: 更新：200mm Veeco Propel MOCVD系统、InZiv microLED测试仪等设备重新挂牌出售
news.summary_zh: 此前挂牌出售的microLED研发与生产设备交易最终未达成，设备未售出并重新回到市场，包括一台全新未使用的200mm Veeco Propel GaN MOCVD系统和一台新的InZiv OmniPix 2.0 microLED测试系统。卖家再次接受新买家及此前表达意向方的报价，可单件或打包购买。
news.why: microLED研发与生产设备出现二次流通机会，利好预算有限的高校、研究所与初创企业。

news.title_zh: LG Display以OLED TV边框缩减34%的技术获专利技术奖大奖
news.summary_zh: LG Display凭借将OLED TV边框宽度缩减约34%的驱动电路技术，获得2026年专利技术奖大奖（世宗大王奖）。该技术自2022年起应用于全部OLED TV面板产品，累计带来3850亿韩元的成本改善效果。
news.why: 驱动电路集成化同时实现窄边框与降本，强化OLED TV在高端电视市场的竞争力。

news.title_zh: LG电子推出电子纸显示屏管理应用
news.summary_zh: LG电子宣布推出可通过智能手机管理商用电子纸显示屏的应用“LG Signage Manager”。LG电子纸显示屏可呈现接近纸质海报的质感，断电后仍能保持画面，且换图耗电低于传统数字标牌，适用于门店菜单与促销信息。

news.title_zh: 青色正成为自动驾驶信号：UDC、OLEDWorks与奥迪将评估浅蓝OLED照明
news.summary_zh: Universal Display（UDC）与OLEDWorks宣布合作评估用于自动驾驶系统（ADS）通信的青色OLED照明，将UDC的磷光蓝OLED材料与OLEDWorks的面板开发与生产经验结合，奥迪也参与评估。SAE J3134推荐规范定义了青绿色ADS标志灯，梅赛德斯-奔驰已在加州、内华达州及德国获得Drive Pilot车辆使用许可，美国NHTSA于10月提议允许但不强制要求青色ADS标志灯。
news.why: OLED照明切入车规信号灯新场景，为磷光蓝材料与车载OLED面板带来潜在增量。

items.title: Lumens Bios (formerly Lumens) to expand its microLED display business
items.abstract: Korea-based LED maker Lumens Bios , known until September 2026 as Lumens, says that it is expanding into next-generation displays, including microLED and micro RGB, while keeping its existing LED business. The company is investing in microLED mass production, in growing its microLED supply to the defense industry, and in micro RGB production equipment. Lumens has been developing microLED displays for years. Its active-matrix microLED microdisplay is used in military weapon sights made by Sweden's Aimpoint, under a supply deal signed in 2022, and the company says that it is still shipping these panels. Back in 2017 Lumens started to produce 0.57" microLED microdisplays and 100" microLED signage prototypes , and in 2023 it developed a monolithic stacked RGB microLED epiwafer .

items.title: Counterpoint: smartphone OLED panel shipments to decline 3% in 2026, while foldable OLED shipments to grow 23%
items.abstract: Counterpoint Research says that global smartphone OLED panel shipments will decline by almost 3% in 2026, from 894 million units in 2025 to 829 million, as the memory supply crisis and rising production costs weigh on smartphone volumes . Rigid (glass-based) OLED shipments are set to fall 24% and flexible OLED shipments will decline 3%, but foldable and rollable OLEDs will grow by over 23%. Smartphone OLED panel revenue is expected to drop by more than 5% this year, due to the weaker shipments and pricing pressure. Next year the market will contract further, but it will recover gradually, reaching 858 million panels in 2028 - still below the 2025 level. Rigid OLEDs will remain under pressure as the industry moves to flexible panels, while foldables, helped by their premium positioning, will be the fastest-growing segment in both shipments and revenue.

items.title: Case study: Yousee Display uses flexible AMOLED and "Zero-Dead-Angle" 3D curved bonding to create expressive robot faces
items.abstract: Humanoid robots are quickly moving from research labs into hotels, shopping malls, classrooms and homes, and a robot's face is fast becoming its most important interface. A display built into the face can show digital eyes, expressions, greetings and operating status, which turns a machine into something people naturally want to interact with. Wrapping a display around a curved robot head is far from simple, though. Imprecise 3D fitting, inconsistent image quality and weak surface protection have so far held back large-scale deployment. Shenzhen-based Yousee Display has solved this challenge with a fully integrated robot-face solution. It combines flexible AMOLED display modules, Yousee's "Zero-Dead-Angle" 3D curved forming and bonding technology, and custom cover lenses, to produce a seamless, continuous digital face with no visible gaps or dead zones.

items.title: Update: the 200 mm Veeco Propel MOCVD system, InZiv microLED tester and other tools are back on the market
items.abstract: Back in June, we listed the MOCVD microLED R&D and production equipment being sold by an East-Coast U.S. company, including a new, never-used 200 mm Veeco Propel GaN MOCVD system and a new InZiv OmniPix 2.0 microLED test system, and later reported strong interest from potential buyers . We now have an update: the deal did not go through in the end, so the equipment has not been sold and is back on the market. This is good news for any company, university or institute that missed out the first time around, as it offers a second chance to acquire these tools. Prices are the seller's recommended figures and are indicative; items are available individually or as a package. The listing drew interest from companies, labs and research institutes, and the seller is once again open to proposals, both from new parties and from those who have already expressed interest.

items.title: Cyan is emerging as a signal for autonomous driving: UDC, OLEDWorks and Audi to evaluate light-blue OLED lighting
items.abstract: Universal Display (UDC) and OLEDWorks announced a collaboration to evaluate cyan OLED lighting for automated driving system (ADS) communication. The two companies will combine UDC's phosphorescent blue OLED materials with OLEDWorks' OLED panel development and production expertise, and Audi is also taking part in the evaluation. Cyan is emerging as the color that tells other road users that a car is driving itself. The SAE J3134 recommended practice defines turquoise ADS marker lamps, and Mercedes-Benz has received permits to use such lights on its Drive Pilot cars in California and Nevada, as well as in Germany. In the US, NHTSA proposed in October to allow, but not require, cyan ADS marker lamps under the federal vehicle lighting standard.
